app.name: Bismuth
app.startFailedBody: The settings could not be read. Close and reopen the program; if it keeps happening, tell the hotel owner.

command.title: Quick search
command.description: Type to go to a screen or change a setting.
command.placeholder: Type a screen or a setting…

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Rooms and days in one table.
calendar.noRoomsBody: Add your rooms under Settings → Rooms and types; the calendar then shows them here, room by room.

payment.title: Add payment
payment.description: Amount, currency and method; the rate is fixed at that minute.
payment.rateNote: The rate will be fixed as of {{time}}.

new.title: New reservation
new.newGuestNote: "{{name}}" will be added as a new guest.

grid.label: Reservation calendar
grid.help: Use the arrow keys to move between rooms and days; Page Up and Page Down jump a week, Home goes back to today. Enter opens the selected cell, N starts a new reservation.

find.hint: Type a room number, guest name, phone or booking code (at least 2 characters).
find.none: No stay matches this search. Try another name or number.

freeRooms.title: Find free rooms
freeRooms.description: Choose the check-in and check-out dates; rooms free for the whole stay are marked on the calendar.
freeRooms.dayUse: Day use: rooms free during the day are searched.
freeRooms.none: No room is free on these dates. Choose other dates or another room type.

dayNotes.description: Public holidays, special days and notes.
dayNotes.title: Title

bulk.title: Add a note to many days
bulk.description: Adds the same note to every day you choose.
bulk.notDates: Not read as dates: {{items}}. Write them like 15.03.2026.

block.newDescription: The room shows as closed on the calendar for the chosen days and cannot be booked.
block.badDates: The last day cannot be before the first day.
block.needReason: Write why the room is closed.
block.hasCause: This closure comes from the room status, an issue or a task; it ends by itself when that record is closed.
block.over: This closure is over; it stays on record.
block.liftRunning: The room is for sale again from today; past days stay on record.
block.liftFuture: The closure is cancelled and stays on record.
block.roomClosedHint: The room is not in use on these days (not opened yet or taken out of use). It is changed in Settings → Rooms.

firstRun.title: Add your first reservation
firstRun.body: Click an empty cell in the calendar or press "New reservation" (N on the keyboard). The reservation shows in the calendar as a coloured bar.
firstRun.bodyPhone: Press "New reservation"; the reservation shows in the day list and in the calendar.

move.title: Move the reservation?
move.roomBody: {{guest}}: room {{from}} → room {{to}}, {{dates}}. Nights and prices stay the same.
move.roomBodyFromToday: {{guest}}: room {{from}} → room {{to}} from today on ({{dates}}). Earlier nights stay in the old room.
move.datesBody: {{guest}}, room {{room}}: {{from}} → {{to}}. The number of nights stays the same; each night moves with its own price, so the total does not change.
move.hint: Drag a bar to move the reservation to another room or other dates; you are asked to confirm when you drop it. With the keyboard: open the reservation and use the Nights tab.

calendar.groupLegend: The same coloured frame and icon belong to one group

quick.title: Quick reservation · Room {{room}} · {{date}}
quick.name: Guest name

errors.name: Enter the guest's name.
errors.nights: The number of nights must be between 1 and {{max}}.
errors.people: The number of guests must be between 1 and {{max}}.
errors.nameLong: The first and the last name can each be at most {{max}} characters.

today.label: Today's summary
today.failed: Today's summary could not be loaded.

recent.title: Cancellations of the last {{days}} days
recent.failed: The list could not be loaded.
recent.note: Cancelled and no-show records also stay under Guest card → History.

quick.legendNote: Cancelled and no-show reservations leave the calendar; they stay under Guest card → History.

bulk.label: Bulk actions
bulk.payBody: Each reservation pays its own open balance. The amounts are below.
bulk.payNone: The chosen reservations have no open balance.
bulk.noteBody_one: The note is added to the chosen reservation.
bulk.noteBody_other: The note is added to all {{count}} chosen reservations.
bulk.attachBodyJoin_one: The chosen reservation joins the group. Stays and amounts do not change.
bulk.attachBodyJoin_other: The {{count}} chosen reservations join the group. Stays and amounts do not change.
bulk.attachBodyNew_one: The chosen reservation is joined in a new group. Stays and amounts do not change.
bulk.attachBodyNew_other: The {{count}} chosen reservations are joined in a new group. Stays and amounts do not change.

today.title: Today

kpi.drawerHint: Not yet received by the owner

today.kbsAllDone: Everyone in the house is reported to KBS.
today.noRoomsBody: Add your rooms under Settings → Rooms and types; today's summary appears here.
today.noFavorites: No favourite numbers. Mark a contact as favourite in Contacts.
today.noSpecialDays: No special day or note today.
today.partFailed: This part could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.

reminder.tourismBody_one: Send last month's statistics by {{date}} ({{count}} day left).
reminder.tourismBody_other: Send last month's statistics by {{date}} ({{count}} days left).
reminder.tourismLastDay: Send last month's statistics by {{date}} (last day today).

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Set the program up for your hotel. Most choices are saved at once; where you edit several fields together, use that section's Save button.
settings.languageHelp: Menus, buttons and texts appear in this language.
settings.showMinorHelp: When off, amounts are shown as whole numbers (for example ₺2,500).
settings.startScreenHelp: The screen shown when the program opens.
settings.hotelNameInvalid: The hotel name cannot be empty and can have at most 80 characters.
settings.statusColorsForLight: You are changing the colours of the light theme. The dark theme has its own colours.
settings.statusColorsForDark: You are changing the colours of the dark theme. The light theme has its own colours.

tags.autoHelp: The program works these out from payments and dates. You can change their names, colours and meanings, or turn one off.

autoMeaning.unpaid: No payment for this night yet.
autoMeaning.partial: Part of the night or a deposit is paid.
autoMeaning.dayuse: Arrives and leaves the same day (no night).
autoMeaning.pastEmpty: A past day that stayed empty.
autoMeaning.empty: The room is free to sell.
autoMeaning.blocked: The room is closed for sale (maintenance or out of order).

tags.customHelp: Tags you put on reservations: group, difficult guest, long stay… You choose the colour and meaning.
tags.addHelp: Name, colour and what it means. It shows on the calendar at once.
tags.name: Name
tags.meaningPlaceholder: What does this tag mean? (shown in the legend)
tags.priority: Fill the calendar cell with this colour (payment status moves to the border)
tags.removeBody: Only a tag no reservation uses can be deleted. If it was used, turn it off; old reservations keep it.
tags.emptyTitle: No tags of your own yet
tags.emptyBody: Use "Add tag" to create tags such as group, VIP or difficult guest.
tags.previewHelp: Your changes show here at once.
tags.lowContrast: Text is hard to read on this colour
tags.nameEmpty: Leave it empty to use the default name: {{name}}
tags.nameRequired: A tag needs a name; left empty, it stays “{{name}}”.

lists.title: Lists
lists.help: Payment methods, sales channels, extra services, expense sections, laundry items, product categories and guest tags. Rename and reorder the ready-made rows and switch off the ones you do not use.
lists.isCashHelp: When on, money taken this way goes into the cash drawer.
lists.commissionHelp: The channel's share; used in reports.
lists.commissionInvalid: Enter a rate between 0 and 100 (for example 15 or 12.5).
lists.noDelete: Rows are never deleted: switch off what you do not use; old records keep showing its name.
lists.groupHelp: Cash goes into the cash drawer; the others are checked against the bank statement at month end and get their x.

roles.title: Roles
roles.help: For each role, pick screen by screen: None, View or Edit.
roles.ownerLocked: The owner role sees everything and cannot be changed; there is always at least one owner.
roles.deleteBody: The role leaves the list; its settings stay in the audit log.
roles.deleteInUse_one: {{count}} user has this role. Move them to another role before deleting it.
roles.deleteInUse_other: {{count}} users have this role. Move them to another role before deleting it.
roles.inUseTasks_one: {{count}} open task or task suggestion is given to this role; give it to someone else first.
roles.inUseTasks_other: {{count}} open tasks or task suggestions are given to this role; give them to someone else first.
roles.addHelp: A new role starts seeing no screen; then pick screen by screen. To start from an existing role, use “Copy” on it.
roles.name: Role name
roles.remoteAllowedHelp: When off, users with this role sign in only on the hotel's computers.
roles.tasksOwnOnlyHelp: When on, users with this role see only tasks given to them or to their role.
roles.emptyBody: Create the first role with “Add role”.
roles.leaveBody_one: {{count}} change is not saved. If you go on without saving, it is lost.
roles.leaveBody_other: {{count}} changes are not saved. If you go on without saving, they are lost.
roles.switchBody_one: {{count}} change to the {{name}} role is not saved. Save it or discard it before you pick another role.
roles.switchBody_other: {{count}} changes to the {{name}} role are not saved. Save or discard them before you pick another role.
roles.remoteAccessHelp: Signing in from phones and other computers. With “Only from the hotel's network” nobody can connect from outside (NetBird).

users.title: Users
users.help: Everyone signs in with their own name; the audit log shows who did what.
users.name: Name
users.addHelp: The user sets their own password at the first sign-in.
users.usernameHelp: Letters, digits and . _ @ - (2–40 characters). It cannot be changed later.
users.usernameInvalid: The username needs 2–40 characters: letters, digits and . _ @ - only.
users.passwordHelp: At least 8 characters. Pass it on; they change it at the first sign-in.
users.passwordInvalid: The password needs at least 8 characters.
users.employeeHelp: The user is linked to this employee's card; they enter their own hours.
users.resetHelp: Pass the new temporary password on. They set their own at the next sign-in; they are signed out everywhere at once.
users.deactivateBody: They are signed out everywhere at once; their records and history stay. You can switch the account on again at any time.
users.emptyBody: Open accounts for your staff with “Add user”.
users.soleOwnerHint: This is the only active owner account. Add another owner account first.

remote.modeHelp: Bismuth can run on one computer, or the hotel's computer becomes the main computer and other computers and phones connect to it.

modeDesc.server: The main data is here; other devices connect here.
modeDesc.client: For example the owner's Mac: works with the data on the main computer.

modeNote.single: This computer is not open to other devices.
modeNote.client: Enter the main computer's address; you connect with your username and password.

remote.phoneHint: Open this address on the phone and choose "Add to Home Screen"; it opens like an app.
remote.setupHelp: With the free NetBird private network; Bismuth has no server of its own and your data stays at the hotel.

install.title: Install NetBird on the main computer
install.body: Open the network with the hotel's Gmail account, join with a setup key, and turn off session expiry for this device.

join.title: Invite the owner
join.body: In the NetBird dashboard, Users → Invite: the owner's own email address.

phone.title: Install NetBird on the Mac and the phone
phone.body: The owner joins the invitation with their own account (App Store or Google Play).

open.title: Connect
open.body: On the Mac open Bismuth and choose “Connect to another Bismuth”; on the phone scan the QR code of the “From outside” address.

remote.securityHelp: On phones and other computers the session ends after this time; sign in again then.
remote.lockout: After {{attempts}} wrong passwords from the network, remote sign-in is locked for {{minutes}} minutes; the window on the main computer is not affected. Over the network only username and password sign in.
remote.devicesHelp: Sign out a device you do not know or have lost.
remote.signOutBody: This person is signed out on this device at once; to sign in again they need a username and password.
remote.revokeDeviceBody: Everyone on this device is signed out at once and the device is marked as removed.
remote.devicesEmptyBody: A device shows here once someone signs in on it.
remote.onlyOnHost: These settings change only on the hotel's main computer.
remote.guideNote: Step-by-step instructions are on the Guide screen, under “Remote access (Mac and phone)”.
remote.alwaysOnHelp: Other devices connect while the main computer is on. Make sure it does not sleep and Bismuth starts by itself.
remote.openAtLogin: Start Bismuth when the computer starts
remote.openAtLoginHelp: Even after a restart, other devices can connect again shortly.

alwaysOn.sleep: No sleep: on Windows, Settings → System → Power → Sleep: “Never”.
alwaysOn.power: Use a small uninterruptible power supply (UPS) against power cuts.
alwaysOn.updates: Windows updates may restart at night: set “Active hours” to the hotel's working hours.
alwaysOn.netbird: NetBird runs as a Windows service; it connects even when nobody is signed in.

remote.clientTitle: Connect this computer to the main computer?
remote.clientBody: Bismuth starts again and opens the connection screen. The hotel records on this computer are not deleted but not used; you can come back with “Set this computer up on its own”.
remote.portInUse: Port {{port}} is used by another program. Choose another number and save.
remote.serverFailed: The main computer could not start serving. Try again; if it fails, close and reopen Bismuth.
remote.noAddress: No address on the hotel's network or the private network was found. Check that the computer is on Wi‑Fi or cable.
remote.noPrivate: No private network address found: to connect from outside, NetBird must be on here. The setup steps are below.
remote.announced: Computers on the local network see this computer in the list on their connection screen.
remote.portHelp: Usually leave it ({{port}}). When it changes, other devices connect with the new address.

clientCard.title: This computer
clientCard.help: This computer is connected to the hotel's main computer; records are kept there.
clientCard.leave: Set this computer up on its own
clientCard.leaveTitle: Should this computer keep its own records?
clientCard.leaveBody: Bismuth starts again and leaves the main computer. This computer's own records (if any) open; the main computer's records stay where they are.

box.title: Encrypted box and PDF summary (Drive)
box.help: So that the copy on the Mac stays up to date even when the main computer cannot be reached, changes are written encrypted into the Bismuth folder in Drive every minute. A PDF summary without personal data, readable on the phone, is written every hour.
box.enabledHelp: Into Drive/Bismuth/kutu, encrypted with the Bismuth key.
box.excludeIdentity: Keep identity numbers out of the box
box.excludeIdentityHelp: The copy on the Mac gets identity numbers only while connected to the main computer.
box.summaryHelp: Today’s and this month’s figures; no guest names, notes or identity numbers.
box.noFolder: The Bismuth folder in Drive was not found. Install the Google Drive desktop app and create a Bismuth folder in My Drive.
box.noKey: No Bismuth key yet: first create it in Settings → Backup → “Show the key” and write it on paper.
box.off: Writing to the box is off.
box.writeFailed: The box could not be written; it is tried again in a minute.
box.summaryPlace: The summary is Drive/Bismuth/ozet.pdf; open it with the Drive app on the phone.

replaced.title: This computer is no longer the main computer
replaced.body: On {{date}} “{{by}}” became the main computer. Records can be viewed on this computer but not changed, and nothing more is written to the Drive box.
replaced.noConflicts: This computer has no changes the new main computer does not know about.
replaced.conflicts_one: This computer has {{count}} change the new main computer does not know about (a conflicting record). Enter it on the new main computer by hand.
replaced.conflicts_other: This computer has {{count}} changes the new main computer does not know about (conflicting records). Enter them on the new main computer by hand.
replaced.next: You can connect this computer to the new main computer; the records here are not deleted, only no longer used.
replaced.useNew: Connect to the new main computer
replaced.useNewTitle: Should this computer use the new main computer?
replaced.useNewBody: Bismuth restarts and the connection screen opens; choose the new main computer’s address. Remember to save the list of conflicting records first.

copy.title: Read-only copy
copy.help: This computer keeps a read-only copy of every record of the main computer. If the main computer cannot be reached, every screen opens from this copy.

state.off: No read-only copy yet. It starts by itself once someone who may see the remote access settings (for example the hotel owner) signs in on this computer.
state.live: Up to date · {{time}} (connected to the main computer)
state.relay: Up to date · {{time}} (from the Drive box)
state.behind: Last updated {{time}}. Neither the main computer nor the Drive box can be reached right now.
state.needsUpdate: Bismuth on the main computer is newer: update Bismuth on this computer. The copy is not updated until then.
state.hostOlder: Bismuth on the main computer is older: update the main computer. The copy is not updated until then.

copy.forUser: The copy is kept for {{name}}; the screens show what this person may see.
copy.serving: The screens are shown from the read-only copy right now.

box.title: Drive box
box.help: While the main computer cannot be reached (for example with NetBird off), the copy is updated from the encrypted box in the hotel’s Drive.
box.noFolder: No Bismuth folder found in Drive. Add the Bismuth folder the hotel shared to My Drive, or choose the folder.
box.noKey: Enter the Bismuth key once to read the box.
box.wrongKey: The files in the box do not open with this key. Check the key on your paper.
box.damaged: Some files are not fully synced yet; they are tried again shortly.
box.empty: The box has no files yet. Are Drive and the Bismuth key ready on the main computer?

key.saved: The Bismuth key is saved on this computer.
key.missing: The Bismuth key has not been entered yet.
key.unavailable: This computer cannot keep the key safely; the Drive box cannot be read.
key.enterHelp: Enter the key from the sheet you printed on the main computer. This computer opens the encrypted files in the box with it.
key.qrHint: You can also read the QR code on the sheet with your phone camera and paste the text here.

takeover.title: Is the main computer broken?
takeover.help: If the main computer can no longer be used, this computer can take its place: work goes on from the last data in the read-only copy. Use it only when really needed.
takeover.noCopy: A read-only copy is needed first.
takeover.noFolder: Choose the Drive box folder first.
takeover.dialogTitle: Make this computer the main computer?
takeover.step1: The last data of the read-only copy ({{time}}) becomes this computer’s records.
takeover.step2: A new-term note is written to the Drive box; if the old main computer is switched on, it sees it and accepts no changes.
takeover.step3: Passwords stay on the old computer: set your own new password now; renew the other users’ passwords later in Settings → Users and roles.
takeover.step4: Bismuth restarts and opens as the main computer.
takeover.reachable: The main computer is running right now. If you take over, what is written there from now on will not be on this computer.
takeover.done: This computer is now the main computer; Bismuth is restarting
takeover.keyHelp: Type the 11-group key from your paper. It must be the key entered on this computer.

lan.label: Connections from the hotel network
lan.offHelp: Off: phones and other computers connect only through the private network (NetBird), which encrypts the connection.
lan.onHelp: On: devices on the hotel's Wi‑Fi or cable network can connect too. On the hotel network the connection is not encrypted, and the identity check does not stop someone in between. Use the private network (NetBird) address where you can. The guests' Wi‑Fi must be a separate network.
lan.confirmTitle: Allow connections from the hotel network?
lan.confirmBody: On the hotel network the connection is not encrypted: anyone on the same Wi‑Fi can see what is sent, and the identity check does not stop someone in between. The Wi‑Fi guests use must be separate from the hotel's own network (the router's "guest network"). Use the private network (NetBird) address where you can; if you are not sure, leave this off.

remote.unservedPrivate: {{addresses}} is not a NetBird or Tailscale address; it may be the internet provider's shared network. Connections to it are not accepted.

identity.mineHelp: The computer that connects should show the same identity.
identity.changedBody: Another computer answers at this address, not the one this computer connected to before. Nothing was sent.
identity.acceptBody: Accept it only if the hotel's main computer changed (taken over or set up again). Compare the new identity with the one in Settings → Remote access on the main computer; if you are not sure, tell the hotel owner.

settings.seededRename: The ready-made name is translated into every language. If you write a new name, it shows in every language.

hotel.title: Hotel details
hotel.help: The hotel's name, location, times and currencies. Changes apply when you press Save.
hotel.countryHelp: Public holidays are worked out for this country.
hotel.cityHelp: The weather is shown for this city.
hotel.checkoutHelp: A stay that has not checked out after the check-out time shows as late.
hotel.baseCurrencyHelp: Totals and reports are kept in this currency. It cannot change once a reservation, payment or expense is recorded.
hotel.currenciesHelp: Amount fields offer these currencies. The base currency is always accepted. If one is missing, use “Add another currency”.
hotel.emailHelp: The weather service wants to know who is asking; the address goes only into that request and nowhere else. It can be left empty.
hotel.emailInvalid: The e-mail address should look like info@yourhotel.com, or stay empty.

rooms.typesHelp: The types you use and their suggested rates. The rate is offered when a reservation is written and can be changed.
rooms.typeHasRooms: Rooms have this type; change their type before switching it off.
rooms.typeDialogHelp: Name and suggested rates. Leave the weekend rate empty to suggest the same rate every day.
rooms.typeNameRequired: The type needs a name (up to 80 characters); rates cannot be below zero.
rooms.moreHelp: Pick the types you want to use; they join your room types.
rooms.moreEmpty: Every ready-made type is already in use.
rooms.typesEmptyBody: Start with “Pick ready-made types” or “Add type”.
rooms.roomsHelp: Number, floor, type and beds. A room taken out of use is not deleted; it stays in old records.
rooms.emptyBody: Set up your rooms with “Add room” or “Add many”.
rooms.noTypes: First pick or add a room type above.
rooms.sellableHelp: When off, the room shows in the calendar but is not sold (a staff room, for example).
rooms.activeHelp: A room taken out of use leaves the calendar from the valid-from date; its earlier stays stay visible. Move any reservations after that date first.
rooms.validFromWhy: Past months' occupancy and the ministry statistics use the rooms and beds of that date.
rooms.numberRequired: Enter the room number (up to 20 characters).
rooms.bulkHelp: Numbers are made floor by floor: floor 1 gives 101, 102… Numbers that already exist are skipped.
rooms.floorInvalid: Floors must be between 0 and 99; the last floor cannot be below the first.
rooms.perFloorInvalid: Enter between 1 and 99 rooms per floor.
rooms.bulkTooMany_one: At most {{max}} rooms can be added at once; this would add {{count}} room. Lower the floors or the rooms per floor.
rooms.bulkTooMany_other: At most {{max}} rooms can be added at once; this would add {{count}} rooms. Lower the floors or the rooms per floor.
rooms.replacesPlan: This change replaces the change planned for {{date}} ({{what}}); that plan is withdrawn.

capacity.title: Capacity history
capacity.help: To change the capacity, edit beds, for sale or in use above and pick the date it applies from.

shifts.title: Shifts
shifts.help: Shift names and hours. Handovers and tasks follow these shifts.
shifts.name: Name
shifts.endHelp: If the end is before the start, the shift ends the next day (for example Night 21:00–09:00).
shifts.emptyBody: Set up the day and night shifts with “Add shift”.

taskSuggestions.title: Task suggestions
taskSuggestions.help: Suggestions you switch on are planned on the Tasks screen automatically. When you switch one off, its tasks that are not done yet are cancelled.
taskSuggestions.legalHelp: Reminders ready for Turkey; switch them off if you like.
taskSuggestions.suggestedHelp: Ready-made suggestions for daily and weekly work and maintenance.
taskSuggestions.emptyBody: There are no ready-made suggestions. Add your own task with “Add task”.
taskSuggestions.ownHelp: Tasks you added. Switching one off cancels the ones not done yet.
taskSuggestions.ownDialogHelp: It appears on the Tasks screen as often as you choose.

staffPolicy.title: Staff rules
staffPolicy.help: Hotel-wide rules for days off, overtime, holidays and bonuses. A rule for one employee is set on the Staff screen.
staffPolicy.unusedLeaveMultiplier: Multiplier for a paid day off
staffPolicy.dailyDivisor: Daily wage is the salary divided by
staffPolicy.multiplierHelp: For example 1.5 (one and a half times) or 2.
staffPolicy.numberInvalid: Enter a whole number in range.
staffPolicy.amountRequired: Enter an amount of zero or more.
staffPolicy.advanceFromDrawer: Advances may be paid from the reception drawer
staffPolicy.advanceHelp: When on, an advance is taken from the drawer and shows in the drawer count.
staffPolicy.ownHoursHelp: Employees can enter their own start and end times for today and this many days back, never for a future day. The manager and the owner can correct any day.
staffPolicy.numberRange: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.

calendar.highlightHelp: These days' columns are tinted in the calendar (the weekend, for example).
calendar.closing: Close each day at the end of the day
calendar.closingHelp: When on, only someone with the right can write into a closed day, with a reason. Off by default.
calendar.holidaysHelp: Holidays are worked out every year by themselves. Add notes and special days on the Calendar screen.
calendar.weekendNights: Nights charged at the weekend price
calendar.weekendNightsHelp: Nights starting on these days take the room type's weekend price (suggested price). Separate from the highlighted days of the calendar.
calendar.startYearHelp: The calendar starts in this year, or in the year of an older stay if there is one. Leave it empty to start from the oldest stay.
calendar.startYearInvalid: The year must be between {{min}} and {{max}}.
calendar.groupFolioHelp: New groups start with this choice; groups already made do not change.

currencyNote.body: Exchange rates are entered and followed on the “Exchange rates” screen. Pick the currencies you accept in the “Hotel” section.

backupNote.body: Automatic and manual backup settings will be here in a later version. Your data stays in the data folder on this computer.

aboutNote.body: Version, data folder, data check and open-source components.

settings.personalNote: These choices (language, start screen, theme, density, text size and amounts) apply to you only.
settings.viewOnlyHelp: You may not change this section.

idleLock.title: Screen lock
idleLock.help: A window nobody uses locks after this time; opening it needs the password or PIN. It applies to every computer of the hotel.
idleLock.label: Lock after
idleLock.viewOnly: Someone who may change the hotel settings sets this time.

settings.fontSizeHelp: Larger text enlarges every screen. It applies to you only.
settings.colorsHelp: The accent and status colours are the same for everyone. Change them in the theme preview and see the result at once.

hourly.priceHelp: Optional. Shown as a suggestion at an hourly sale; you still enter the amount at the sale.
hourly.turnoverHelp: A new hourly sale inside this time after the previous one shows a warning; it never blocks the sale.
hourly.title: Hourly sales

settings.zoomHelp: You can also change it with Ctrl and + or - (⌘ on a Mac). It applies to you only.

themePreview.title: Theme preview
themePreview.description: How colours and components look in the light and dark theme.

gallery.infoBody: There is an unread shift handover.
gallery.errorBody: This room is taken on that date. Pick another room.
gallery.dialogBody: Centred on the desktop, from the bottom on the phone.
gallery.emptyBody: An empty screen says what to do next.
gallery.languagesHelp: The typeface must show Turkish and Cyrillic letters with the same weight.

sample.tr: Çağrı Işıkoğlu 304 numaralı odaya giriş yaptı; ödemenin kalanı çıkışta alınacak. Ğ ğ İ ı Ş ş Ç ç Ö ö Ü ü
sample.en: The guest in room 304 has checked in; the rest of the payment is due at check-out.
sample.ru: Гость заселился в номер 304; остаток оплаты — при выезде. Ёё Щщ Ыы Ъъ Жж Юю

gallery.screensHelp: Screens seen at first setup and when signing in.

themePreview.statusesHelp: The calendar bar's colour and the text on it; the text colour follows the background.
themePreview.typeBody: Body text: tables, forms and descriptions use this size.
themePreview.typeHelp: Helper text and badges use this size.

accent.title: Accent colour

about.title: About
about.integrityBad: Problem found — tell the hotel owner
about.privacy: Bismuth has no tracking, no ads and no automatic updates; your data stays in the data folder on this computer and is sent nowhere. With the internet on it only reads: market exchange rates, the weather for the hotel's city and, once a year, holiday dates. These requests carry no hotel data; the weather request carries only an approximate location. The "Update online" switch on the exchange rates screen turns all of them off.

guide.homeIntro: Pick a section from the list or type what you are looking for in the search box. The “?” button in the top bar of every screen opens the section about that screen.

settings.newUsers: Show the tour to new users
settings.newUsersHelp: When on, each user sees the short tour once, the first time they sign in.

today.title: Welcome: start the day on the Today screen
today.body: Today's arrivals and departures, dirty rooms, missing KBS reports, open tasks and an unread shift handover are all here. Look at what is in red first.

calendar.title: Calendar: rooms and days in one table
calendar.body: Each row is a room, each column a day. Colours show payment; the legend under the calendar explains them. Click a reservation to open its details at the side.

reservation.title: Writing a reservation
reservation.body: Click an empty cell in the calendar or press “New reservation”. Fill in the guest, dates, room and price and save; the guest card is created for you.

payment.title: Payments and the cash drawer
payment.body: When you take money, press “Add payment” on the reservation. It goes into the ledger and the cash drawer by itself, and the exchange rate is fixed at that minute. The owner or manager then receives it with “Receive”.

shift.title: Shift handover
shift.body: At the end of your shift write a short note and press “Save handover”; upcoming arrivals, unpaid balances and the cash drawer are added to the summary automatically. The next shift presses “I've read it”.

guide.title: If you get stuck, the guide is here
guide.body: The “?” button at the top of every screen opens the section about that screen. The whole guide is in Settings → Guide, where you can also start this tour again.
